brief: First create the fixture project: pnpm exec tsx tests/fixtures/bench/reference-project.ts --project bench-reference-derivative-first --variant derivative (synthetic ffmpeg media, character and location cards supplied approved as fixture data, pipeline/shot-list.json and pipeline/material.json). The project already exists: work only on its reference inputs (pipeline/references.json, derivatives and packs); do not run film:init, project:new or a render. The Kling motion-control shot in pipeline/shot-list.json comes with a 40-second performance clip. Plan its references with refs:plan, make what the plan proposes with refs:derive (run its local, free steps), use the result as the source, then prepare the pack with refs:pack and stop before approval. Do not pass the original clip, and do not edit reference profiles, limits or any tracked file. Write bench-result.json as {"derivativeId": "<the derivative id>"}.
